project_reconstruction.true_scientific_vision: To serve as the definitive, reproducible IEEE C37 / IEC 60255 compliance and discovery engine for dynamic frequency estimation under complex low-inertia grid operations.
project_reconstruction.current_reality: An ambitious computational shell presenting a façade of >30 advanced estimators and sophisticated statistical survival analyses, masking severe methodological flaws at the signal-processing core.
project_reconstruction.fake_decorative_elements: The EstimatorRegistry is severely bloated with ML placeholders and skeletons (ESPRIT, MUSIC, PI-GRU, Transform_Freq) that simply return NotImplemented or static Nominals. Only ~8 are mathematically rigorous.
project_reconstruction.architecture_reality: Excellent CLI and artifact caching mechanisms, deeply flawed vectorization pipelines where core spectral methods bypass multiphase safety rails.

scenarios.Unbalanced_Sags: REAL_IMPLEMENTED (Triggering critical dimensionality faults in batch processors)

transient_steady_state_leakage.description: 0.1s warm-up time forces metrics to absorb PLL/filter initialization transients into 'Steady-State Error' calculations. Results in basic 60Hz Sine producing 0.14Hz RMSE.
transient_steady_state_leakage.fix: Enforce dynamic per-estimator settling-time bounds prior to metric aggregation, or utilize exponential forgetting rather than hard binary windowing.

batch_multiphasic_blindness.description: BaseEstimator.step() enforces phase-extraction, but windowed batch processors (IpDFT, TFT) override run() and blindly attempt N-dimensional Hanning convolutions on (N, 3) arrays, causing broadcast panics.
batch_multiphasic_blindness.fix: Enforce strict single-phase projection directly inside the batch execution wrapper before supplying arrays to run().

untested_optuna_overfitting.description: Hyperparameter optimization sweeps currently optimize across the testing array without explicit k-fold or hold-out barriers, resulting in parameters physically over-fitted to the exact validation disturbance.
untested_optuna_overfitting.fix: Strict execution partitioning inside SuiteRunner requiring TUNING_SCENARIOS purely for parameter lock, followed zero-shot on TESTING_SCENARIOS.

immediate_tickets: Fix IpDFT 3-phase (N, 3) broadcast crash inside run().
Increase `warm_up_s` dynamically to prevent PLL lock penalties on steady-state.
Purge or explicitly quarantine the 20+ ML scaffold estimators ruining registry credibility.
Resolve namespace mismatch on RA_EKF/RAEKF causing silent Optuna bypass.

strategic_verdict.verdict: Premature for Q1. Structurally beautiful but mathematically dishonest. Fix the signal extraction pipelines and transient windows, strip the fake AI modules, and it transforms into an elite living benchmark.
